Hi Jake —

Thanks for the clear asks — cc'ing Priyom (SE) to address the technical items.

Quick answers & attachments:
- Encryption: Redwood supports AES-256 in-transit and at-rest. Customer-managed KMS is supported (AWS KMS, GCP KMS); we can also integrate with HSM-backed keys for private deployments. See attached encryption_summary.pdf.
- Retention: default application logs are retained 90 days; we offer configurable retention windows for audit logs and tenant-level data in Dedicated/Private deployments — we can provide a retention config template if that helps.
- SOC 2: attaching the latest non-redacted SOC 2 report and control matrix (soc2_packet_updated.pdf). If you need a notarized copy or additional attestations, let me know and we’ll escalate with our security team.

Next steps: 1) Priyom — can we schedule a 30-min tech review with Jake & Sarah this week? 2) Jake — if security is good with these artifacts, can you confirm a gate timeline for the pilot?

Thanks —
